description: This file contains utility functions for file operations such as checking existence, creating hard links, directory management, file copying, reading, and path manipulation, primarily used within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It also includes platform-specific code for Linux and macOS, and functions for waiting on file or socket states.

classes.name: InotifyWatcher
classes.description: A RAII class that manages an inotify watch, adding it upon construction and removing it upon destruction.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path, optionally following symlinks.

methods.name: FileDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID of the file at the given path.

methods.name: CanHardLink
methods.description: Checks if two files are on the same device, indicating they can be hard linked.

methods.name: FileInodeNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the inode number of the file at the given path.

methods.name: AreHardLinked
methods.description: Checks if two files are hard linked by comparing device ID and inode number.

methods.name: CreateHardLink
methods.description: Creates a hard link from target to hardlink, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: FileHasContent
methods.description: Checks if the file at the given path has a size greater than zero.

methods.name: DirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns a list of entries in the directory at the given path.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the given path, optionally following symlinks.

methods.name: EnsureDirectoryExists
methods.description: Creates a directory and its parents if they do not exist, sets permissions and group.

methods.name: ChangeGroup
methods.description: Changes the group ownership of a path to the specified group name.

methods.name: CanAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current process has specified access permissions to a path.

methods.name: IsDirectoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty.

methods.name: RecursivelyRemoveDirectory
methods.description: Removes a directory and all its contents recursively.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies a file from one path to another, using sendfile for efficiency.

methods.name: AbsolutePath
methods.description: Converts a relative or special path to an absolute path, resolving symlinks if requested.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file at the given path.

methods.name: MakeFileExecutable
methods.description: Sets executable permissions on a file.

methods.name: FileModificationTime
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of a file as a time_point.

methods.name: RenameFile
methods.description: Renames a file from current to target filepath.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Deletes a file at the given path.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: ReadFileContents
methods.description: Reads file contents into a string, returning a Result.

methods.name: CurrentDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: SparseFileSizes
methods.description: Returns the size and disk usage of a sparse file.

methods.name: FileIsSocket
methods.description: Checks if a path is a socket.

methods.name: GetDiskUsage
methods.description: Returns disk usage in bytes for a given path.

methods.name: FindImage
methods.description: Searches for an image file matching patterns in a directory.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Finds a file with a specific name within a directory tree.

methods.name: WalkDirectory
methods.description: Recursively enumerates files and directories, invoking a callback.

methods.name: WaitForFile
methods.description: Waits until a file exists or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocket
methods.description: Waits until a Unix socket is available and in listening state.

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocketListeningWithoutConnect
methods.description: Waits until a Unix socket is in listening state without connecting.

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePath
methods.description: Converts a relative or special path to an absolute path, resolving symlinks, considering current working directory and home directory.
